meta_description: 28K likes, 355 comments - bellapoarch on September 18, 2026: "my debut album Picnic At The Cemetery is finally out & im feeling very emotional & happy that i get to share it with u. i hope this album can take u to a different place & i hope u find something there that u can keep. i built this world & these characters because it’s easier for me to tell my story through them. & by the end of making this album, i realized that i was healing the younger version of myself. i now sit here with my buried memories & emotions & celebrate life because the experiences i went through made me who i am today. thank u to every single person that helped me & encouraged me to push my creativity with this body of work. i hope this album can help u the same way it helped me🤍".
